posts.zh:
dsh-joi-channel-theme 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1a9dbf31314c1ff726df.html
posts.en:
dsh-joi-channel-theme is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-1a9dbf31314c1ff726df.html
